mapper.select:
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TASK WHERE STATUS <> 'DELETED' AND USER_ID = #{userId} AND DUE_DATE >= TO_DATE(#{startDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND DUE_DATE < TO_DATE(#{endDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') + 1
AND CATEGORY_ID = #{categoryId}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TASK WHERE STATUS <> 'DELETED' AND TASK_STATUS <> 'DONE' AND USER_ID = #{userId} AND DUE_DATE < TRUNC(SYSDATE) AND DUE_DATE >= TO_DATE(#{startDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND DUE_DATE < TO_DATE(#{endDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') + 1
AND CATEGORY_ID = #{categoryId}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TASK WHERE STATUS <> 'DELETED' AND TASK_STATUS = 'DONE' AND USER_ID = #{userId} AND DUE_DATE >= TO_DATE(#{startDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND DUE_DATE < TO_DATE(#{endDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') + 1
AND CATEGORY_ID = #{categoryId}

SELECT C.TITLE AS groupKey, COUNT(*) AS count FROM TASK T JOIN TASK_CATEGORY C ON C.CATEGORY_ID = T.CATEGORY_ID WHERE T.STATUS <> 'DELETED' AND T.USER_ID = #{userId} AND T.DUE_DATE >= TO_DATE(#{startDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND T.DUE_DATE < TO_DATE(#{endDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') + 1 AND C.STATUS <> 'DELETED' GROUP BY C.TITLE ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC

SELECT T.TASK_ID AS taskId, T.TASK_TITLE AS taskTitle, C.TITLE AS categoryName, T.PRIORITY AS priority, T.TASK_STATUS AS taskStatus, TO_CHAR(T.CREATED_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS createdDate, TO_CHAR(T.DUE_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS dueDate,
CASE WHEN T.TASK_STATUS = 'DONE' THEN TO_CHAR(TL.COMPLETED_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') ELSE NULL END AS completedDate
FROM TASK T
LEFT JOIN TASK_CATEGORY C ON C.CATEGORY_ID = T.CATEGORY_ID
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT TASK_ID, MAX(CREATED_DATE) AS COMPLETED_DATE FROM TASK_LOG WHERE AFTER_STATUS = 'DONE' GROUP BY TASK_ID ) TL ON TL.TASK_ID = T.TASK_ID
WHERE T.STATUS <> 'DELETED' AND T.USER_ID = #{userId} AND T.DUE_DATE >= TO_DATE(#{startDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND T.DUE_DATE < TO_DATE(#{endDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') + 1
AND T.CATEGORY_ID = #{categoryId}
ORDER BY CASE T.TASK_STATUS WHEN 'DONE' THEN 1 WHEN 'DOING' THEN 2 WHEN 'TODO' THEN 3 ELSE 4 END, T.DUE_DATE DESC, T.TASK_ID DESC

SELECT T.TASK_ID AS taskId, T.TASK_TITLE AS taskTitle, T.CREATED_DATE AS createdDate, T.DUE_DATE AS dueDate, TL.COMPLETED_DATE AS completedDate
FROM TASK T
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT TASK_ID, MAX(CREATED_DATE) AS COMPLETED_DATE FROM TASK_LOG WHERE AFTER_STATUS = 'DONE' GROUP BY TASK_ID ) TL ON TL.TASK_ID = T.TASK_ID
WHERE T.STATUS <> 'DELETED' AND T.USER_ID = #{userId} AND T.TASK_STATUS = 'DONE' AND T.DUE_DATE >= TO_DATE(#{startDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND T.DUE_DATE < TO_DATE(#{endDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') + 1
AND T.CATEGORY_ID = #{categoryId}

SELECT TO_CHAR(TRUNC(DUE_DATE, 'IW'), 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "date", COUNT(*) AS "count" FROM TASK WHERE STATUS <> 'DELETED' AND TASK_STATUS = 'DONE' AND USER_ID = #{userId} AND DUE_DATE >= TO_DATE(#{startDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND DUE_DATE < TO_DATE(#{endDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') + 1
